title: Harness-S: Learning from Sibling Harnesses for Generalizable Agent Training
why: Harness-S builds a Sibling Harness Pool via Directional Harness Evolution and Complementary Harness Rescue Training, then transfers capabilities into a policy that still runs under the original harness. Explicit multi-harness evolution for generalizable agent training.
mechanism: Directional Harness Evolution develops specialized sibling harnesses along distinct repair directions; Complementary Harness Rescue Training invokes the fixed Sibling Harness Pool only on base failures and transfers rescued capabilities into one policy under the original harness.
